body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1014, merge `e5393834c715396a60967d366523712edd5d1b65`, head `aacd405178d93211a2d9db73d1eb91a52939a7dc`, closed issue #998.

The retained `data/regional-review/followup-serbia-422-admin-crosswalk-20261005/reproduce.py` reads its current filesystem source/workbooks, captured issue, prior subject assessment and prior geoBoundaries metadata without verifying their whole-file hashes or resolving the declared immutable baseline. `source/baseline-inputs.json` records pins, but the runner never enforces them. It unconditionally overwrites eight historical outputs in `sources/derived/`, and writes the first four before checking the exact 78-subject scope or current-match acceptance. This allows changed provenance to pass and a failing run to replace part of the historical report set.

Actual isolated positive verification: two original main executions read the native 2017 `.xls` and current `.xlsx` and generate eight deterministic outputs. Seven outputs match the historical bytes exactly; the only differences in `reproduction-summary.json` are the actual Python/pandas runtime version fields. The 58,129-byte crosswalk retains SHA256 `a5a01d678c51cf273aa5afd8194d10c1b103176f8fe30ac50d0ccc9e69ec2751`. Actual verification runtime is Python 3.12.14, pandas 2.2.3, xlrd 2.0.2 and openpyxl 3.1.5; it does not claim the historical 3.8.5 / 1.1.3 runtime. Native source decoding independently agrees with all 198 old and 197 current normalized workbook data rows. No source or historical report was edited; only exact output destinations and their reads/mkdir were redirected into exclusive fresh private directories.

Executed failure triggers using complete-file read-boundary fixtures:

- For `data/regional-review/regional-review-3c4fe25a21fa428d/source/gb/SRB-ADM2-geoBoundaries-SRB-ADM2-metaData.json`, retain every field except set `boundaryYear` to `AUDITOR_SYNTHETIC_VINTAGE`. Keep the whole original geometry, workbooks and 78-subject scope unchanged. The original runner succeeds with all 78 matches, 13 parent partitions and 19 urban-municipality rows. It emits the synthetic year in every crosswalk row; the changed 59,767-byte CSV SHA256 is `042b944cfb090166db3ba888dda825687eed3ce1d5af47afd42036e968dda30a`. The source metadata hash should have been rejected before emission.
- For the whole `source-issue-998.json`, remove only the last ID from its machine block's subject roster, leaving a 77-ID subset. The original runner raises `AssertionError: Issue scope must contain exactly 78 unique subjects`, but only after emitting four reports: the partial subject crosswalk, both normalized rosters and parent summary. Their original destinations would overwrite retained reports, while the other four historical outputs remain from the earlier run. A reported failure therefore does not preserve the evidence set.

Expected: verify actual immutable complete input/packet/code hashes, native/source inventories and the complete exact scope before any report emission. Use only fresh exclusive versioned outputs, fail without any partial reports, and preserve all historical source/code/report bytes. This is a provenance, validation-order and evidence-preservation defect; the positive checks do not show that the original historical crosswalk is wrong.

Bounded additive source-only geography erratum, at most two PRs, owned exclusively under `data/regional-review/serbia-register-reproduction-998-erratum/`:

- Add a new separate guarded reproducer/erratum using the 35 whole baseline and packet-context pins below, with explicit immutable baseline `c944e017796005726150abef19763db9ffd07154`. Exact research subjects remain the 78 #998 native IDs; the 13 parents, 145-feature source and remaining workbook rows are read-only context. Validate source, issue, prior assessment/metadata and code bytes, all exact subject/type/parent matches and all 13 register partitions before emitting any result.
- Retain two deterministic runs to exclusive fresh outputs, compare with historical originals, and record meaningful negatives for both complete-file probes above, wrong baseline/source/workbook/code bytes, unmatched/duplicate scope and existing output. Prove each rejection emits no reports and leaves old bytes unchanged. Preserve truthful actual runtime versions instead of forcing historical values into new receipts.
- Retain a new versioned manifest with complete consumed-file accounting, actual metric/output/control bindings and substantive independent exact-head implementation/source review. Any new scientific or geographic claim requires its applicable evidence/domain review. Keep all source vintage, statutory-register and polygon limitations explicit.

Success: the changed metadata is rejected before reports; the 77-subject fixture fails with no partial output; all complete consumed inputs and added dependencies are pinned and accounted for; exact 78 native IDs, 13 parent contexts and original IDs/history are preserved; two deterministic fresh runs and genuine negative controls are retained. Original old script, register workbooks, source geometry, snapshots, prior packets and eight reports remain byte-identical. Do not change shared helpers, hierarchy or geometry. No imports, merging, deployment or geographic approval is authorized.

Readiness: #998 is closed with its canonical claim released. Complete open/closed issue and open-PR pagination found no issue/PR owning this original packet's safeguard defects or the new path. Existing #1156 addresses the distinct original #423 packet and remains under its own blocked scope; #1159 addresses the original #422 packet, while closed #1017 has a separate 67-subject Serbia scope. Their claims, dates, ownership and results remain untouched. Available whole retained sources suffice for this mechanical erratum; no official polygon or missing institutional-page restoration is a prerequisite. No implementation reservation is taken.

Limits: the Auditor checked complete world identity coverage, source/Atlas/name/code links and native workbook rows; all 78 rows and 13 selected primary-register partitions reproduce. The retained PDF is a dated cartographic map attributed internally to RGA, not a polygon dataset. Independent official URL/capture/rights authentication, the institutional register/terms/methodology bodies and official dated polygons remain unavailable under GitHub-only access. Counts, transliterated names and roster set equality do not establish legal boundary accuracy, current governance, whole-country completeness or the Belgrade parent's geographic role. Do not use this issue to resolve those source/geography questions. The original PR audit remains Incomplete and a corrective PR must be audited separately.

The original 35-whole-input phase with eight MiB output reserve is 31,763,710 bytes. Auditor native decoding/rendering and dependency preparation used a separately admitted 90,846,892-byte phase including 362,926 bytes of xlrd source from GitHub commit `3a19d22014d7b3f3041b7188d21a653c18c709bf`, plus a 64 MiB decode/output reserve. Scope verification across all 36 whole world parts was a separate complete phase, 226,100,899 bytes. Each ordinary/decoded object is below 32 MiB, each complete phase below 256 MiB, and descriptors below 512. Recalculate admission for new work; no chunk/extract/stream cap bypass.

Complete metadata probe fixture: 919 bytes, SHA256 `83fd350882500111a1ebcfbc6840a119a03097c465a76fde57cf663c1967668e`. Complete shortened-scope fixture: 15912 bytes, SHA256 `1f3785a8bb71c2d474ab9c426326b5f82d9bfa24a2df53aac4d71ad7bf7d00d4`. Neither was written over an actual input.
